caseNameFull: Crichton, doing business as Super Service Motor Freight Co. v. United States
attorneys: Messrs. William A. Roberts, Edgar Turlington, James E. Wilson, and Mrs. Irene Kennedy for appellants., Solicitor General Fahy and Mr. Daniel W. Knowlton for the United States et al., and Mr. Mortimer Allen Sullivan for Associated Transport, Inc. et al., appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted, and the judgment is affirmed. (1) North Coast Transportation Co. v. United States, ante, p. 668; Carolina Scenic Coach Lines v. United States, ante, p. 678; (2) Alton R. Co. v. United States, 315 U. S. 15, 24; and (3) United States v. Pan American Petroleum Corp., 304 U. S. 156, 158.
